g1.label: 1. When we got to the library, all the desks ___ (go).
g1.why: The desks were taken before we arrived: had + past participle.

g2.label: 2. By the time I started university, I ___ English for eight years.
g2.why: By the time + past simple points to the earlier past: past perfect.

g3.label: 3. While I ___ (wait) for the bus…
g3.why: After while, the longer action in progress takes the past continuous.

g4.label: 3. … I ___ (realise)…
g4.why: The sudden short action during the wait takes the past simple.

g5.label: 3. … that I ___ (leave) my laptop at home.
g5.why: I left the laptop before I realised it: past perfect.

g6.label: 4. By the time the lecturer ___ (arrive)…
g6.why: After by the time, the later point in the story takes the past simple.

g7.label: 4. … we ___ (finish) our slide.
g7.why: Finishing came before the lecturer arrived: past perfect.

g8.label: 5. She ___ (feel) nervous…
g8.why: The main situation in a past story takes the past simple.

g9.label: 5. … because she ___ (not / prepare) her notes.
g9.why: Not preparing came before feeling nervous: hadn't + past participle.

g10.label: 6. What ___ (you / do) when the fire alarm went off?
g10.why: A question about an action in progress: was/were + subject + -ing.

g11.label: 6. … when the fire alarm ___ (go) off?
g11.why: The short interrupting action takes the past simple; go → went.
